scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w web-dashboard" "npm run dev -w data-processor"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev -w web-dashboard" "npm run dev -w tcp-server" "npm run dev -w data-processor"
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infra.yml up -d postgres redis kafka
scripts.infra:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.infra.yml logs -f postgres redis kafka
scripts.db:push:timescale: sh -c 'TS_USER=$(grep -E "^TIMESCALE_USER=" .env.production 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d "\"" || echo postgres); TS_PASS=$(grep -E "^TIMESCALE_PASSWORD=" .env.production 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d "\""); DATABASE_URL="postgresql://${TS_USER:-postgres}:${TS_PASS}@localhost:5433/fleet_vision?schema=public" npx prisma db push --schema=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && docker exec fv-timescaledb psql -U ${TS_USER:-postgres} -d fleet_vision -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/010-init-timescaledb.sql'
